Name: Apache Log4j Remote Code Execution (Log4Shell)
Description: The remote host runs a version of Apache Log4j 2 affected by Log4Shell, allowing unauthenticated remote code execution via crafted JNDI lookups in logged strings.
Solution: Upgrade Apache Log4j to 2.17.1 or later, or apply the vendor's mitigation for the affected application.

Name: Apache Log4j Remote Code Execution (Log4Shell)
Description: The remote host runs a version of Apache Log4j 2 affected by Log4Shell, allowing unauthenticated remote code execution via crafted JNDI lookups in logged strings.
Solution: Upgrade Apache Log4j to 2.17.1 or later, or apply the vendor's mitigation for the affected application.

Name: Microsoft Windows SMBv1 Enabled
Description: The remote Windows host supports SMBv1, a deprecated protocol vulnerable to several remote code execution flaws and used by ransomware for lateral movement.
Solution: Disable SMBv1 via Group Policy or the DisableSMB1 registry setting and enable SMB signing.

Name: SSL/TLS Birthday Attack (Sweet32)
Description: The remote service supports 3DES cipher suites, which are vulnerable to the Sweet32 birthday attack against 64-bit block ciphers.
Solution: Disable 3DES and other 64-bit block cipher suites in the TLS configuration.

Name: Microsoft RDP Remote Code Execution (BlueKeep)
Description: The remote host is affected by BlueKeep, a wormable remote code execution vulnerability in Remote Desktop Services reachable without authentication.
Solution: Apply the Microsoft security update for CVE-2019-0708 and restrict RDP exposure with network-level authentication.

Name: SSL Version 3 (POODLE)
Description: The remote service supports SSLv3, which is vulnerable to the POODLE padding-oracle attack.
Solution: Disable SSLv3 and use TLS 1.2 or later.

Name: Spring Framework RCE (Spring4Shell)
Description: The remote application uses a version of Spring Framework affected by Spring4Shell, allowing remote code execution via data binding on JDK 9+.
Solution: Upgrade Spring Framework to 5.3.18 / 5.2.20 or later and redeploy the application.

Name: SSL Certificate Cannot Be Trusted
Description: The SSL certificate for this service cannot be trusted because the certificate chain could not be validated to a known CA.
Solution: Install a certificate signed by a trusted certificate authority.

Name: SSH Weak Algorithms Supported
Description: The remote SSH server is configured to allow weak key exchange or MAC algorithms.
Solution: Disable weak SSH algorithms in sshd_config and restart the service.

Name: Windows Print Spooler RCE (PrintNightmare)
Description: The remote Windows host is affected by PrintNightmare, a Print Spooler remote code execution vulnerability that can lead to domain compromise.
Solution: Apply the Microsoft security update for CVE-2021-34527 and restrict Point and Print via Group Policy.
